battle.name: 漢平南越
battle.brief: 公元前111年，漢武帝元鼎六年以五路大軍分進，討滅以番禺為都的南越國。主力恃樓船、戈船沿靈渠串連的湘江漓江珠江水系南下，弩手登岸攻壘，南越則倚番禺城與越騎死守。卡面亞述長弓屬前700年的西亞複合反曲弓，與本役相隔近六百年，未現於嶺南戰場；其角木筋技術的後裔在漢代以弩的形制落地。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 西漢一方是中央直轄的郡縣徵發體系。漢武帝元鼎六年（前111年）下詔發兵，兵分五路：伏波將軍路博德出西北，取道山嶺，自北越石門一線南趨番禺；樓船將軍楊僕自零陵沿湘江北行，過靈渠轉入灕水，循西江下行入珠江，水軍為全役主力；戈船將軍率師出夜郎，循牂柯江即西江水路東下；貲虓司馬馬援出交趾道，攻擊句町，斷南越南翼；第五路由越騎將軍韓千秋率騎兵與海路部隊自琅邪、會稽一線沿海南下。各路兵員來自關中、中原、會稽、蜀地及新平郡縣，多為編發之卒，輔以刑徒、貲虓與南越降卒，總數史書概稱「十餘萬」。南越一方則是以趙佗建立的割據王國：國王趙眜在番禺，相國呂嘉總攝政事，太官、內史、宗正、將軍、渠帥各有所部，兵為南越土人及歸附越人，配弓弩、環首刀與舟師水軍，並徵句町、甌駱諸部為外翼。漢軍以樓船、戈船、鬥艦沿水道展開，南越則倚番禺城與嶺南山險作戰，雙方在五路會師於珠江口這一段，才真正短兵相接。
countriesEn: The Western Han side was a centrally controlled system of levies drawn from the commanderies and counties. In the sixth year of Yuanding (111 BC) Emperor Wu ordered troops into the field and split them into five columns. The Fubo General Lu Bodu took the north-western route, crossing the mountains and driving south from the Shimen line in northern Vietnam towards Panyu. The Louchuan General Yang Pu moved down from Lingling along the Xiang River, the Li River and the Pearl River, and his fleet was the main force of the whole operation. The Gouchuan General marched out of Yelang and came east down the Zangke River, that is, the western waterway. The Cilu Sima Ma Yuan took the Jiaozhi road, struck at the Gouting, and cut away the southern wing of Nanyue. The fifth column, under the Yueqi General Han Qianqiu, rode and sailed south along the coast from the Langya and Kuaiji line. Their men came from the capital region, from the central plains, from Kuaiji, from Shu and from the newly pacified commanderies, mostly conscripted infantry, with convicts, ciliu and surrendered Nanyue men mixed in; the histories give the overall figure in round numbers as something over a hundred thousand. The Nanyue side was a separatist kingdom founded by Zhao Tuo. The king, Zhao Mo, sat at Panyu, while the chancellor, Lü Jia, held the real power, with the grand household, the neixishi, the zongzheng, the generals and the qu shuai each commanding their own men. Their troops were southern Yue people and assimilated Yue, armed with bows and crossbows, ring-pommel sabres and a river flotilla, and they drew on the Gouting and the Ou-luo peoples as an outer wing. The Han drove their war with the louchuan, the gouchuan and the doujian fleets along the waterways; Nanyue fought behind the walls of Panyu and among the fastnesses of the Lingnan mountains. Only when the two sides met along the Pearl estuary did the fighting come down to close quarters.
people: 漢武帝劉徹是這場戰爭的決策者。真正把開戰理由做實的，是他兩年之間的兩次動作：元鼎五年（前112年），漢廷派博士弟子終軍出使番禺，終軍以口辯迫南越王接受內屬，卻被相國呂嘉擋回，終軍回報後自剄明志（《史記·南越列傳》《漢書·終軍傳》），說自己身處蠻夷而不辱使命已足夠；元鼎六年（前111年），漢兵已集，趙眜與其母樛夫人謀誅呂嘉，事洩反被呂嘉所殺，南越內部自此崩解。漢將方面，路博德善於長途陸進，楊僕督造樓船、水軍犀利，馬援年方二十餘、以貲虓司馬將兵於交趾，斬首數千級，開闢南路戰局，韓千秋率騎兵沿海路南下、率先攻城。南越一邊，呂嘉任相數十年，權柄在手，能左右國王的去就，趙佗的舊制在他手上運作得最完整；他死守番禺到底，兵敗之後往東甌方向逃亡，最終為東甌方面所殺，首級獻漢。史書記載此役始末的，主要是《史記·南越列傳》與《漢書·南越傳》，二者互有出入，但大事次序相合。
peopleEn: Han Wudi, Liu Che, was the decision-maker behind this war. What turned his intention into the actual business of arms was a pair of moves across two years. In the fifth year of Yuanding (112 BC) the court sent the erudite scholar Zhong Jun as envoy to Panyu; Zhong Jun argued the Yue king into accepting submission to Han, was blocked by the chancellor Lü Jia, and on his return killed himself to make his point, saying that it was enough for a general to have exposed himself among the barbarians without staining his mission. In the sixth year of Yuanding (111 BC), with the Han armies already assembled, Zhao Mo and his mother, Lady Jiu, plotted to remove Lü Jia; the plot was discovered and the two were killed instead, and the state of Nanyue began to come apart from within. Among the Han commanders, Lu Bodu was the master of the long land march, Yang Pu supervised the construction of warships and commanded the strongest element of the fleet, Ma Yuan, still in his twenties and holding the rank of Cilu Sima, campaigned through Jiaozhi and cut off several thousand heads there, opening the southern theatre, and Han Qianqiu fought in the front ranks and was killed in the assault. On the Nanyue side, Lü Jia had been chancellor for decades, held authority in his own hands and could decide whether the king went or stayed, and the system that Zhao Tuo had founded worked most completely under him. He held Panyu to the end, fled towards the Ou after his defeat, and was finally killed by the Ou side, who sent his head to Han. The chief sources for the course of the campaign are the liezhuan on Nanyue in the Shiji and the account of Nanyue in the Hanshu.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長弓，是前700年前後亞述帝國的角木筋複合反曲弓，長不足一米，弓臂以木為芯，外貼牛角片、繞筋成三層，握把與弓梢常飾金屬或骨飾，亞述弓兵以弓開路、與斧矛盾車配合，在兩河流域的車陣與攻城戰中反覆使用。它在公元前111年的嶺南並不存在：南越與漢朝的射手用的是本地竹木弓與更關鍵的弩。真正有意思的是技術譜系——角筋複合反曲弓由西亞傳入中亞草原，再東傳蒙古高原與中原，漢代觶與弩機所用的角木筋弓臂，與亞述弓共享同一套材料工藝，只是把張弦的力改由機械的弩機傳遞，射程與穿透力遠勝手弓。漢軍裝備以弩為核心：蹶張弩、擘張弩配大型弩機，單兵可反覆擊發，另有環首刀、鐵矛、長戟、劍與盾；水軍有樓船、戈船、鬥艦與走舸。南越方面，出土於廣州象山南越王墓的鐵環首刀與成組銅戈，連同廣州西漢墓屢見的銅弩機與鐵箭鏃，顯示南越已用鐵器並以弩為主，粵人又善舟楫與水網中的標槍，兩軍在珠江水面的差距，主要不在弓，而在船與弩的規模。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card is the horn-wood-sinew composite reflex bow of the Assyrian empire around 700 BC. It is under a metre long, its belly built on a wooden core faced with plates of horn and wound with sinew in three layers, with the grip and the tips often fitted with metal or bone. Assyrian archers opened the way for the army, working with axe, spear, shield and chariot, and used the bow again and again in the chariot formations and the sieges of Mesopotamia. Such a bow did not exist in the Lingnan of 111 BC: the archers of Nanyue and of Han used local bamboo-and-wood bows and, above all, the crossbow. What is genuinely interesting is the technical pedigree. The horn-and-sinew composite reflex bow travelled from Western Asia into the Central Asian steppe and then east to the Mongolian plateau and the central plains, and the composite arms used for the Chinese jue bow and for the crossbow limbs in the Han share the same body of material and craft with the Assyrian bow. The difference lies in the delivery of the draw: the mechanical trigger of the crossbow took over the work of the string, giving far greater range and penetration than a hand bow. The Han army was built around the crossbow, with the ti-zhang and the bo-zhang crossbows and their heavy trigger blocks, letting a single man shoot again and again, backed by ring-pommel sabres, iron spears, long halberds, swords and shields; on the water there were louchuan, gouchuan, doujian and zouge vessels. On the Nanyue side, the iron ring-pommel sabres, bronze gous and crossbow trigger parts excavated from the tomb of the king of Nanyue at Xiangshan in Guangzhou show that iron and the crossbow were already in use, and the Yue were at home with the boat and with the throwing spear in the netted waters. The gap between the two fleets on the Pearl was not a matter of the bow at all, but of the sheer weight of ships and crossbows.
tactics: 漢軍的打法是典型的漢式大戰役：先以五路分進形成包圍，再以水軍鎖住江面，最後合圍攻城。楊僕的樓船隊自零陵沿湘江北行，過靈渠轉入灕水，再循西江下行入珠江，舟師在上游展開，弓弩手居高臨下射擊城牆與江面目標；弩的射速雖不及弓，但張力大、射程遠，一次齊射足以壓制城頭守軍。路博德一軍翻越嶺南山脈，攻破石門後直插番禺西北，切斷南越與北越、以及句町、甌駱方向的聯繫；馬援自交趾攻句町，奪其城邑，切斷最南的退路與外援；戈船軍沿牂柯江東下，等於從西面把南越的縱深壓縮。合圍完成後，漢軍不急於強攻，先以舟師巡江、斷絕糧道與援兵，再以步卒列陣築柵逼近，衝鋒時以弩齊射覆蓋，以長兵破陣。南越則利用番禺城在山間的險固與城牆，逐段抵抗，並以弓弩、落石與突出部反擊，試圖拖到越地雨季或等到援軍；呂嘉的判斷是守住城池就有翻盤，但城中糧秣終有盡日，城破之後南越軍官佐各自奔散，降者不絕。
tacticsEn: The Han method was that of a characteristic Han grand campaign: five columns first to form the encirclement, then the fleet to lock the river, and only then the siege. Yang Pu's louchuan column came from Lingling up the Xiang water into the Li River, turned through the Lingqu into the Pearl River, and deployed the flotilla in the upper reaches, where the crossbowmen shot down from height onto the walls and onto targets on the water. The crossbow fires more slowly than a bow, but its tension is high and its range long, and a single volley was enough to pin the defenders on the wall. Lu Bodu's column crossed the Lingnan mountains, broke through at Shimen and drove straight into Panyu from the north-west, cutting Nanyue off from the northern Viet and from the Gouting and the Ou-luo; Ma Yuan struck at the Gouting from Jiaozhi and took its strongholds, closing the southernmost line of retreat and of reinforcement; the gouchuan column came east down the Zangke, compressing the depth of Nanyue from the west. Once the ring was closed the Han did not rush the walls. They first patrolled the river with the fleet, cutting the grain road and the flow of reinforcements, then advanced with infantry in line, throwing up fences and screens, covering each charge with a crossbow volley and breaking the line with the long weapons. Nanyue used the strength of Panyu among its mountains, its walls, section by section, answering with bows, with stones dropped from above and with sorties from the projecting towers, hoping to hold until the rains of the south or until help came. Lü Jia's judgement was that as long as the city held there was still a chance; but grain in a besieged city always runs out, and after the walls fell the officers and men of Nanyue scattered, and the surrenders went on without end.
data: 可考的數字大致如下。時間：出兵在元鼎六年（前111年）秋，漢廷下詔到番禺城破，前後不足一年；正史只記「秋」，未確月，本卡取九月。兵力：漢軍五路，總數史書概稱「十餘萬」，此數含郡縣編發之卒、刑徒、貲虓與降人，並非全數投入攻城一線；馬援部在交趾一路斬首數千級，記的是戰果而非兵力。距離：長安至番禺約一千六百公里，古道迂迴，實際行程更遠；零陵至番禺為水路，經湘江、靈渠、灕水、西江、珠江；西北一路自北越石門南下，越嶺而行；靈渠為秦始皇時所鑿，長約三十六公里，溝通湘漓，是本役水軍能入珠江的關鍵。城池：番禺為南越都城，越秀山一帶1990年代起考古發掘出宮城城垣、殿堂基址與菱形花紋石板水道，說明城防是長期經營的永久建築，與一般村寨不同。工藝與物資：南越冶鐵、銅器與造船業發達，1983年廣州象山南越王墓出土「蕃禺少內」銅鼎、鐵環首刀與成組銅戈，廣州西漢墓另出銅弩機與鐵箭鏃，是南越兵器水平最硬的物證。漢軍傷亡與南越軍最終死傷數字，傳世史籍皆無記載。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. Date: the campaign was fought in the autumn of the sixth year of Yuanding (111 BC), and less than a year separates the imperial order to move from the fall of Panyu. The histories record only that it was autumn and give no month, so the card takes September. Strength: the Han force was in five columns, and the histories give the total in round terms as something over a hundred thousand; that figure covers levies from the commanderies, convicts, ciliu and surrendered men, and was not all of it committed to the assault on the city. Ma Yuan's men cut off several thousand heads on the Jiaozhi road, which is a record of results and not of numbers. Distances: from Chang'an to Panyu is about two thousand five hundred li; from Lingling to Panyu is a water route, by the Xiang River, the Li River, the Lingqu and the Pearl River; the north-western column came down from Shimen in northern Vietnam over the ridges; the Lingqu was cut by the Qin and is about thirty-six kilometres long, joining the Xiang and the Li, and it was the key that let this army's fleet into the Pearl. The fortress: Panyu was the capital of Nanyue, and excavations at Yuexiu Hill from the 1990s have brought to light the ramparts of the palace city, the foundations of the halls and a stone-lined water channel with a diamond pattern, showing that the defences were permanent works built up over long years, quite unlike an ordinary village stockade. Craft and supplies: Nanyue had developed ironworking, bronze casting and shipbuilding, and the tomb of the king of Nanyue at Xiangshan in Guangzhou, excavated in 1983, yielded the bronze ding inscribed Fanyu Shaonei, iron ring-pommel sabres and crossbow trigger parts, the hardest physical evidence yet for the standard of Nanyue arms. Figures for Han casualties and for the final Nanyue losses are simply not preserved in the transmitted histories.
cause: 這場戰爭的起因是多層的。最深的一層是漢朝要打通嶺南：從長安到南海的通道此前斷在南越，而南越地跨今廣西、廣東與越南北部，漢廷若要在西南夷道上與南海郡之間連成一氣，必須先解決南越。前135年漢使唐蒙出使夜郎、開通西南夷道之後，南越的阻隔愈顯得關鍵。第二層是南越本身拒絕內屬。趙佗建立的南越國起初對漢稱臣，後來趙佗及趙佗之孫趙眜相繼稱帝、拒絕漢使、閉關自守；漢朝要求南越去帝號、置官吏、貢奉財物，呂嘉主持的相府一概不答。到元鼎五年，終軍之死（自剄明志）成了導火線；到元鼎六年，趙眜與樛夫人密謀除掉呂嘉反被殺死，說明南越內部也清楚只有靠漢才能保住政權，卻已無力照辦。漢廷遂以「南越不內屬、殺漢使」為名，會同北越、西南的軍事部署，於元鼎六年秋分五路用兵。
causeEn: The causes of this war lie in several layers. The deepest is the Han court's need to open up the Lingnan. The road from Chang'an to the South Sea had been cut off at Nanyue, and Nanyue straddled what are now Guangxi and Guangdong together with northern Vietnam, so if the court was to join the south-western road and the Nanhai commandery into one line, Nanyue had to be settled first. After Tang Meng was sent to Yelang in 135 BC and the south-western road was opened, the obstruction that Nanyue posed became all the more critical. The second layer is Nanyue's own refusal to be brought inside. The kingdom Zhao Tuo founded at first submitted to Han, but Zhao Tuo and his grandson Zhao Mo in turn assumed the title of emperor, refused Han envoys and closed the passes against them. Han demanded that the south should drop the imperial title, set up Han officials and send tribute, and the chancellery under Lü Jia refused every point. By the fifth year of Yuanding the death of Zhong Jun had become the fuse; by the sixth year, the plot by Zhao Mo and Lady Jiu to remove Lü Jia had ended with the plotters themselves killed, which showed that the Nanyue leadership understood too that only an alliance with Han could preserve the regime, and had no strength left to carry it out. The court therefore took the refusal to be drawn inward and the killing of Han envoys as its pretext, and moved in five columns in the autumn of the sixth year of Yuanding.
impact: 南越亡國之後，漢廷在舊地置九郡：南海、蒼梧、鬱林、合浦、交趾、九真、日南、儋耳、珠崖，以番禺為南海郡治，漢朝的郡縣體系第一次完整覆蓋珠江流域與越南北部，南越國作為獨立政權從此消失。這次征服的後果不只在版圖。嶺南從此納入中原王朝的行政與交通網絡，漢朝的鐵器、牛耕、水利與文字隨郡兵與移民進入越地，越人墓葬與器物形制在往後數百年明顯轉向漢式；番禺則從一國之都變成郡治所在，成為嶺南的行政與物資中心，漢代的海外貿易與海路經營也以此為起點。對外，漢朝在北方的壓力沒有減輕，反而在南方補上一塊：南越是漢廷在南方唯一同匈奴有使節往來的對象，消滅南越，使匈奴失去南下的大陸橋梁與盟友，漠北之戰的戰略前提由此具備。越南北部的句町、貲越諸部也被捲入漢朝郡縣體系，後來伏波將軍路博德、馬援再平交趾一帶，漢朝的影響力從番禺一路推到紅河下游。司馬遷在《史記·南越列傳》為南越立傳，其後班固《漢書》立《南越傳》，這場戰爭也成為後世王朝處理南方邊疆的教科書案例。
impactEn: After the fall of Nanyue the court set up nine commanderies over the old territory: Nanhai, Cangwu, Yulin, Hepu, Jiaozhi, Jiuzhen, Rinan, Danzhu and Zhaya, with Panyu as the seat of Nanhai. For the first time the Han commandery and county system covered the whole of the Pearl basin and of northern Vietnam, and Nanyue as an independent polity disappeared from the map. The consequences of the conquest were not only territorial. The Lingnan was drawn into the administrative and transport network of the central plains, and Han iron, ox ploughing, waterworks and script travelled into the Yue lands with the soldiers and the settlers, while the shape of Yue tombs and of Yue objects turned markedly Han in style over the following centuries. Panyu changed from the capital of a kingdom into the seat of a commandery and became the administrative and supply centre of the Lingnan, and it was from here that Han maritime trade and the management of the sea routes began. Abroad, nothing lightened the pressure on Han in the north; on the contrary, the south gained a missing piece, for Nanyue was the only Han-side base and channel of contact that the Xiongnu had in the southern half, and its removal denied the Xiongnu a land bridge and an ally for their moves to the south, so that the strategic preconditions for the battle in the northern desert were in place. The Gouting and the ci-yue peoples of northern Vietnam were drawn into the Han commandery system as well, and the Fubo generals Lu Bodu and Ma Yuan later pacified the Jiaozhi region again, carrying Han influence from Panyu down towards the Red River. Sima Qian gave Nanyue its own liezhuan in the Shiji, and Ban Gu later raised a account of Nanyue in the Hanshu; this war also became a textbook case of how the later dynasties handled the southern frontier.
result: 公元前111年秋，五路漢軍會師番禺，南越國滅。呂嘉死守至城破前，兵敗出走，終為東甌方面所殺，首級獻漢；趙眜與樛夫人此前已被呂嘉所殺，趙眜一系的王統就此中斷，餘眾或降或散，番禺城中大量官佐與將士向漢軍投降。漢廷隨即廢南越國而置九郡，設南海郡治番禺，郡以下置縣，漢朝郡縣與編戶齊民的治理從此延伸到五嶺以南；分郡設治的同時，漢廷還把嶺南的貢賦、水運與海防納入常制。對南越自身而言，這是一次徹底的軍事覆亡：賦予趙佗一系百年基業的割據王國僅存九十餘年，番禺的宮室與城垣在征服後相繼被拆毀或改作他用，南越的青銅與鐵器武備、越人舟師的水戰傳統，都隨國家機構的瓦解而散入民間。漢朝則在兩年後（前109年）平定西南的滇國，把南疆與西南一併納入版圖，嶺南從此成為帝國的南門，而不再是邊外之地。
resultEn: In the autumn of 111 BC the five Han columns met at Panyu and the state of Nanyue was destroyed. Lü Jia held the city until the moment before its fall, was defeated and fled, and was finally killed by the Ou side, who sent his head to Han. Zhao Mo and Lady Jiu had already been killed by Lü Jia, and with them one line of the royal house of Zhao was cut off for good; the rest either surrendered or scattered, and a great many officers and soldiers of Panyu gave themselves up to the Han army. The court at once abolished the kingdom of Nanyue and set up the nine commanderies, with the seat of Nanhai at Panyu and counties below the commandery, so that Han commanderies, counties and registered households reached south of the Five Ranges for the first time. Alongside the division into commanderies the court also brought the tribute, the water transport and the coastal defence of the Lingnan into the standing system of administration. For Nanyue itself this was a total military destruction: the separatist kingdom that had given the house of Zhao Tuo a century of foundations lasted only some ninety years, the palace halls and ramparts of Panyu were pulled down after the conquest or turned to other uses, and the bronze and iron armaments of Nanyue and the Yue tradition of river fighting were scattered into private hands as the machinery of the state fell apart. Han, for its part, pacified the Dian kingdom in the west in the same year, bringing the southern border and the south-west together into one empire, and the Lingnan became the southern gate of the empire rather than a place beyond the frontier.
